name: HelloCircuitState
description: Demo state for the hello-circuit page, seeded from the URL hash (e.g. #closed, #closed&v=24, #short). Nothing is persisted; production starts with the switch open at the bulb's rated voltage.

name: Circuit3DState
description: Demo state for the 3D circuit page, seeded from the URL hash (e.g. #closed&v=24&t=2.5&cam=60,25,9). A fixed t freezes animation time so captures are pixel-stable; cam sets orbit yaw,pitch,distance. Nothing is persisted; production starts with the switch open at the bulb's rated voltage and a live clock.
